interpretation: Historical strata determine sampling only. They are not human truth. No images, pairing, alignment or annotations have been verified.

provenance.draw_hash_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON sample array with sorted keys, comma/colon separators, no final newline; see canonical_bytes

release_gates: Recover original media and verify hashes
Establish endpoint alignment and documented entity/camera identity
Freeze rubric, scorer configuration, private draw and rendering/blinding plan before new labels
Create isolated images with randomized opaque IDs and a separate restricted mapping

sampling_design.algorithm: Python random.Random(seed).sample without replacement; six strata in declared order; population and selected rows sorted by canonical source ID within stratum
sampling_design.weights_scope: All sampled chunks, before any recovery/annotation nonresponse; never transfer missing-case weights to replacements silently.

visibility: PRIVATE SAMPLING MANIFEST; NEVER DISTRIBUTE TO RATERS
